name: DF-Invoice Query-AJIO
subject: Request for Resolution of DF-Invoice Query-AJIO
body:
Hello Team,

I hope this message finds you well.

We have encountered a query related to the invoices in the attached Excel file. I kindly request that you review the file in detail and address the issue as soon as possible. Once the query for each party is resolved, please highlight the relevant rows in the Excel file for easy reference.

Your prompt attention to this matter is highly appreciated. Kindly inform me once the issue has been resolved, and feel free to reach out if any further clarification or information is needed.

Thank you for your cooperation, and I look forward to your prompt response.

Warm regards

ASHISH MAHAPATRA
